name: Solenne Atelier Vantablack Devotion Robe
description:
A floor-length ceremonial robe by Solenne Atelier's spiritual commission line, constructed in collaboration with the Church of the Signal Unbroken. The outer layer is Vantablack-treated silk-analog — a material so light-absorbent that the wearer appears to be a hole in space. Inner lining is hand-embroidered with gold-thread circuit diagrams representing the BCI neural communion ritual. The hood is structured to frame neural port hardware as crown-like adornment.

Each robe is commissioned individually. No two embroidery patterns are identical — the circuit maps reflect the wearer's personal neural signature.
functionality: BCI port framing in the hood collar displays neural hardware as intentional ornamentation. Thermal underlining regulates temperature during long ceremonies. Hem is weighted for controlled movement during ritual procession.
what_it_says: This person has wealth, faith, and the conviction to merge both into a single visible statement.
worn_by: Church of the Signal Unbroken clergy
story_hooks: The neural signature embroidered into a deceased cleric's robe contains an encrypted data fragment — someone needs it extracted without the Church knowing.
A counterfeit version has appeared on the Shelf, worn by someone claiming spiritual authority they don't have.
The Vantablack treatment is sourced from a single Shelf-based chemist who has just been disappeared.

physical_description.visual_profile: A floor-length ceremonial robe that creates an optical void around the wearer's silhouette. The outer surface appears to absorb light rather than reflect it, creating an uncanny absence against any background. The structured hood frames the head like a crown, emphasizing neural port hardware as sacred geometry. Movement reveals fleeting glimpses of inner gold embroidery—brief flashes of intricate circuit patterns that seem to glow from within the darkness.
physical_description.fit: Loose, flowing, and deliberately voluminous through the body. The hood is architecturally structured to accentuate the upper torso and head. Sleeves are wide and dramatic, tapering slightly at the wrist. The robe moves like liquid shadow, pooling at the floor with deliberate architectural precision.
physical_description.primary_material: Vantablack-treated silk-analog outer layer paired with hand-embroidered silk lining. The treatment creates near-total light absorption (99.7%+ light absorption). Inner lining is premium grade silk with gold-thread work.
physical_description.texture: Outer surface is impossibly smooth and matte—visually flat, almost tactile in its lightlessness. The silk-analog has a subtle whisper-soft hand. Inner lining is smooth silk with raised embroidery—delicate gold thread creating textured circuit maps that catch light only from within.
physical_description.color_scheme: Vantablack (the outer layer appears as pure absence—darker than the shadow it casts). Interior reveals intricate gold-thread circuit diagrams in luminous contrast against dark silk backing. Occasional platinum accent threading highlights neural pathways.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures along the front placket—concealed within the folds, signaling Tier 1 corpo manufacturing. No visible fasteners; the robe drapes and settles through friction-fit layering.
distinctive_features: Vantablack-treated surface creates optical void effect—wearer appears as negative space
Structured hood designed to frame neural ports as crown-like adornment
Hand-embroidered interior lining with unique circuit-diagram maps reflecting wearer's individual neural signature
Gold-thread neural pathway embroidery only visible from within or during movement
Custom commission—no two robes have identical embroidery patterns
Floor-length with architectural pooling at hem
Subtle Solenne Atelier mark—embroidered in platinum thread at inner neckline
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—commission-only piece representing the absolute apex of spiritual/corpo fashion collaboration
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by members of the Church of the Signal Unbroken during BCI neural communion rituals. Signals deep engagement with transhumanist spirituality, wealth, and access to cutting-edge material science. Wearer is positioned as enlightened intermediary between digital and flesh consciousness.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine—custom pieces are maintained by commission. Gold embroidery may show subtle wear patterns along inner seams from repeated ritual use, but outer Vantablack surface remains unblemished.
